meta.name: list-hygiene-monitor
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "watch my list health over time", "flag decaying / unengaged subscribers on a schedule", "why is my open rate drifting down / bounces creeping up", or "build me a re-permission and prune worklist"; runs the scheduled SEND list-decay + suppression-drift watch — an engagement-recency cohort read (30/90/180/365-day), hard-bounce and spam-complaint trend vs benchmark, suppression-list growth/leakage check, and a segmented re-permission / sunset / prune worklist tied to SEND S (list hygiene) and E (engagement-decay) sub-items. Not for the one-time pre-send authentication pre-flight — use deliverability-qa; not for the consent/suppression record itself — use consent-registry; not for computing the EQS or enforcing vetoes — use email-quality-auditor. 邮件列表健康度监控/退订漂移/沉睡用户清理

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定期监控邮件列表健康度，自动生成清理与再许可工作清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果运营邮件列表，需要自动追踪订阅者活跃度与退信趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Monitor email list health on schedule and auto-generate re-permission and prune worklists
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run email lists and need automated tracking of subscriber engagement and bounce trends.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会定期分析你的邮件列表健康度：按最近打开/点击时间将订阅者分组（30/90/180/365天），对比硬退信和垃圾投诉率的变化趋势，检查退订名单是否增长或泄漏，并生成一份分段的重新许可/静默/清理工作清单。
howto.when: 当你要求“监控列表健康度”、“标记沉睡用户”、“分析打开率下降或退信上升的原因”，或要求“生成重新许可和清理工作清单”时触发。

say.text: 监控我的邮件列表健康度，这是ESP导出数据。
say.note: Claude 会分析参与度分层和退信趋势。

say.text: 打开率在下降，退信在上升，对比上季度基线告诉我该清理谁。
say.note: Claude 会生成重新许可/静默/清理清单。

say.text: 运行定期卫生检查：参与度分层、退信趋势和清理清单。
say.note: Claude 会输出分段工作清单和S/E子项读数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude periodically analyzes your email list health: cohorts subscribers by last open/click (30/90/180/365 days), trends hard-bounce and spam-complaint rates against a baseline, checks suppression-list growth/leakage, and produces a segmented re-permission/sunset/prune worklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "watch my list health", "flag decaying subscribers", "analyze open rate drop or bounce increase", or "build a re-permission and prune worklist".

say_en.text: Monitor my list health; here is the ESP export.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze engagement cohorts and bounce trends.

say_en.text: Open rate is dropping and bounces rising; trend against last quarter and tell me who to prune.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a re-permission/sunset/prune worklist.

say_en.text: Run the scheduled hygiene check: engagement cohorts, bounce trend, and prune worklist.
say_en.note: Claude will output a segmented worklist and S/E sub-item reads.
